script.spoken: Why tap water sickened 403,000 people in Milwaukee. In 1993, a parasite slipped through water treatment. About 4,400 people were hospitalised. Cryptosporidium shrugs off chlorine, so filters must catch it. The outbreak cost about $96 million. Schools even threw out 68,000 servings of Jell-O. Millions rely on filters they never see. That's why filtration is the quiet hero of tap water.
